members.name: id
members.doc: Unique id, reported by `onValueChange` when the item is pressed.

members.name: label
members.doc: Name shown in the tooltip and announced to screen readers.

members.name: icon
members.doc: The icon, usually an SVG sized around 45% of the tile.

members.name: open
members.doc: Draws a quiet dot under the icon, for something that is running in the background.

members.name: separatorBefore
members.doc: Draws a thin divider before this item, to split the dock into groups.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Keeps the item visible but not pressable.

members.name: onSelect
members.doc: Runs when the item is pressed, after the bounce starts.

types.name: DockProps
types.doc: An app dock: tiles magnify around the cursor, show their name in a tooltip, bounce when pressed, and the active one carries a dot. Magnification is for mouse and pen only; touch and reduced motion get a still dock.

members.name: value
members.doc: Id of the active item (controlled). Pass null for none.

members.name: onValueChange
members.doc: Called with the id of the pressed item.

members.name: size
members.doc: Tile size at rest, in pixels.

members.name: magnification
members.doc: How much the tile under the cursor grows: 1.6 means 60% larger.

members.name: range
members.doc: Distance in pixels over which the magnification falls off to nothing.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the dock bar.
